name: ETL Sizmek To MySQL
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Sizmek as the data source.
2.  Select your added MySQL data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Sizmek account using the [+](https://api.datachannel.co/datasources/sizmek/credentials/add?token=eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImQwNWI0MDljNmYyMmM0MDNlMWY5MWY5ODY3YWM0OTJhOTA2MTk1NTgiLCJ0eXAiOiJKV1QifQ..Kjd_Boba7eTAorJoUV0bf9o7tj_mrisC96Fq4924pLPNYTHqVJ9-27K8pqltfOwoV0fbV84FeyvLO3dmseQEnCXl8f6FGvzl3FArKt7sWl2bETZsabFmZqivgf9YGUzXMFpTyCneo-2iRbddtVBGSyuz8_sJAVkiy1RdaFmjEDQjL4NkB1reXLkoRpuDq01JQbEZdFSMmMWZSbPXS891rB8WaqLVtWxK-KfifNBOLizfzfYpW33cg7i9T6b6l4OtAWZ5dN1hN6lWGaNJa0dGy4r2GEzQjGRNklKNChqBcZ1uRbBmdX2u6TDYPcRFxrjssfBrWGtCjSCWtLAl2vgf_g) icon with your **Username, Password & API Key.**
